column1: # Contraction clitics: suffix<TAB>the words it stands for.
# The reader finds the suffix on any token and splits the token into its stem
# and these words, so no pronoun is listed ("we're" -> we are, "don't" -> do not).
# Only the unambiguous clitics are here. `'d` (would/had) is left out on purpose:
# it is as ambiguous as `'s` and the reader must abstain on it, not guess; add it
# here only together with a resolver. `'s` (is/has/possessive) is resolved
# by the word that follows it (contraction_s.tsv). Irregular whole forms whose
# stem the suffix cannot give ("won't") are in contraction_exception.tsv, which
